+# Author integration checklist (not independent review)
+
+- Existing reconcile_chunk and operational reconcile public booleans remain. Private typed tuples carry write counts to the scheduler; summary increments occur after commit, and already closed/replayed identities contribute zero. Existing source claims, HTTP implementation, reservation and operational receipt interfaces remain unchanged.
+- New source child is independent and bounded, respects source_enabled before maintenance/poll, shares the existing due/fairness/operational scheduler, and closes its connection in finally. Supervisor owns at most one child of each kind and existing shared shutdown behavior. No new runtime service or credentials.
+- Migration09 is additive and mirrored. The sole established control change replaces unconditional readiness placeholders with explicit prerequisites; existing history/monotonic/generation/rollback predicates remain. Readiness records are service-only; no automatic attestations or activation. Bounded mapping certification does not claim code compatibility; baseline completion read scans are documented. No changes to old role/claim/physical SQL mechanisms.
+- Accepted Task10 clean-schema definitions lacked ledger rows05/06; the repair records those definitions only. Existing selected migration replay is the regression evidence.
+- Existing terminal cleanup behavior was composed in an ordinary expired archive/replacement fixture. Old pending rows, replacement, compact marker and authorization history are retained. Archive-clock injection is confined to the accepted local test fixture.
+- TS fixtures retain strict owned random-loopback checks. Default unit lane excludes DB files; owned allowlist is explicit/sequential. Fixture max:1 permits existing raw migration transactions; no assertion or target guard removed. Two inherited tombstone mocks now implement the current wrapper, preserving tombstone-before-write and exactly-one-live-write assertions.
+- Billing helper and card extractions fix concrete Next route/page export errors only. Existing function/component bodies are unchanged. No pricing, premium/standard copy, subscription behavior, checkout action, model settings or props changed.
+
+## Actual React checklist
+
+Applied `vercel:react-best-practices` from `skill://plugin_connector_690a90ec05c881918afb6a55dc9bbaa1/react-best-practices/SKILL.md` to app/billing/page.tsx and components/billing/TierCard.tsx.
+
+- Structure: TierCard is a top-level named component in its own module; page exposes only default/dynamic/metadata App Router exports. Direct imports; no barrel or heavy new dependency.
+- Server/client: TierCard remains a server component; existing SubscribeButton remains the client boundary. No use-client widening or secret/request-state serialization introduced.
+- Async/data: BillingPage retains existing parallel Promise.all subscription/plan/tier reads; extraction adds no fetch, waterfall, cache or mutable module state.
+- Hooks/state: no new hooks, effects, state or subscriptions. Derived caps remain a small render calculation; no unjustified memoization.
+- Accessibility/render: existing heading, plan identity/current badge, keyed feature list, price text and SubscribeButton semantics preserved exactly. No behavior/visual redesign.
+- TypeScript: existing Plan/EntitlementMap and prices prop contract retained; no new any, boundary cast or JSON parser. Existing typed Object.entries assertion moved unchanged.
+- Verification: existing two-case component test plus helper route mocks; final typecheck/lint/build phase. Actual RolefitBoard browser evidence covers lifecycle views, not an authenticated live billing interaction.
+
+## Resource sampling boundaries
+
+Four Popen children: (1) actual reviewer.worker.main/import with fake DB and process_one sleeping two seconds, no model/provider; (2) actual maintenance worker module; (3) actual archive export_once orchestration with FakeS3 injected (not reviewer.archive_worker module); (4) actual source_worker module with source disabled. Supervisor timing is separately exercised by deterministic tests; the supervisor process is NOT part of the RSS/CPU sample. Parent pytest/observer and PostgreSQL backend memory/CPU are excluded from RSS/CPU sums. DB session peak DOES include the fixture observer, and excludes the fake reviewer connection. Samples every20ms can miss brief peaks; CPU is the maximum observed sum of still-present child counters, not lifetime accumulated CPU after child exits. Wall time ends when the reviewer-ready marker and other three successful exits are observed. It is a finite offline startup/turn sample, not sustained all-flags-enabled runtime sizing or cost neutrality.
+
+## Verified owned reset housekeeping
+
+Current source ce256 adds only an optional isolated-harness ownership tuple and test reset helper. Existing-service child environment cannot inherit it. Helper validates live connection shape, exact immutable container ID/invocation label and matching random127.0.0.1 published port, then checkpoints only a committed clean reset in autocommit and restores mode. No environment/credential inspection, product SQL, guard/deadline override or synthetic size credit. Full current38117/16 both passed; old failures/slow phases and readonly file/wait observations retained. This ordinary positive invocation is not a new independent ownership/security mechanism review.

+import React from 'react';
+import {createRoot} from 'react-dom/client';
+import {RolefitBoard} from '@/components/rolefit/RolefitBoard';
+import {DEFAULT_FILTERS} from '@/lib/rolefit/filter';
+import type {ApplicationPackage,JobRow} from '@/lib/types';
+import '@/app/globals.css';
+const base:JobRow={id:'',title:'',location:'Remote',location_canonicals:['Remote'],remote:true,closed_at:null,
+  first_seen_at:'2026-09-01T00:00:00Z',company_name:'Offline Fixture',ats:'greenhouse',human_override:false,
+  verdict:null,role_category:null,seniority:null,work_arrangement:null,pay_min:null,pay_max:null,pay_currency:null,
+  pay_period:null,headcount:null,skills_score:null,experience_score:null,comp_score:null,fit_score:null,skill_gaps:[]};
+const discovery=[{...base,id:'discovery-1',title:'Discovery page one',fit_score:90,verdict:'approve'},
+  {...base,id:'discovery-2',title:'Discovery page one extra',fit_score:90,verdict:'approve'}];
+const history=[{...base,id:'prepared',title:'Retained prepared role',closed_at:'2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'},
+  {...base,id:'applied',title:'Retained applied role',closed_at:'2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'}];
+const pkg=(jobId:string,status:'prepared'|'applied'):ApplicationPackage=>({jobId,status,
+  resume:{name:'Ada',headline:'Saved résumé',contact:'ada@example.test',summary:'Retained résumé summary',skills:['TypeScript'],experience:[],education:[],certifications:[]},
+  coverLetter:{greeting:'Dear team,',paragraphs:['Retained cover letter body'],closing:'Sincerely,',signature:'Ada'},
+  prefilledAnswers:[{question:'Historical orphan question',answer:'Retained historical answer'}],
+  descriptionSnapshot:'Immutable application JD',questionsSnapshot:null,applyUrl:null,profileVersion:null,
+  resumeInstructions:null,coverLetterInstructions:null,resumeInstructionsDraft:null,coverLetterInstructionsDraft:null,
+  coverLetterEditedText:null,preparedAt:'2026-09-01T00:00:00Z',appliedAt:status==='applied'?'2026-09-02T00:00:00Z':null});
+const actions=async()=>{throw new Error('Fake browser write action must not run');};
+createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<RolefitBoard jobs={discovery} initialHistory={history}
+  historyPage={1} historyTotal={1000} discoveryTotal={500} nowIso='2026-10-07T12:00:00Z' isAuthed
+  initialFilters={DEFAULT_FILTERS} saveResume={actions} rejectJob={actions} unrejectJob={actions}
+  markApplied={actions} unmarkApplied={actions} hasProfile viewerEmail='fixture@example.test' resumeText=''
+  currentProfileVersion={null} initialPackages={[pkg('prepared','prepared'),pkg('applied','applied'),pkg('discovery-1','applied')]} initialRejected={[]}/>);

+// Actual RolefitBoard browser; fake server props/actions/navigation/data only. No auth/providers.
+const path=require('node:path'),fs=require('node:fs'),http=require('node:http');
+const root=process.cwd(),dir=__dirname;
+const esbuild=require(path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules/esbuild'));
+const {chromium,expect}=require(path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules/@playwright/test'));
+(async()=>{
+  const output=path.join('/tmp','task13-browser-bundle');fs.mkdirSync(output,{recursive:true});
+  await esbuild.build({entryPoints:[path.join(dir,'entry.tsx')],bundle:true,outdir:output,jsx:'automatic',platform:'browser',define:{'process.env.NODE_ENV':'"development"','process.env':'{}'},tsconfig:path.join(root,'dashboard/tsconfig.json'),nodePaths:[path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules')],plugins:[{name:'offline-boundaries',setup(build){
+    build.onResolve({filter:/^next\/navigation$/},()=>({path:'navigation',namespace:'offline'}));
+    build.onResolve({filter:/^@\/app\/actions\//},args=>({path:args.path,namespace:'offline'}));
+    build.onLoad({filter:/.*/,namespace:'offline'},args=>{
+      if(args.path==='navigation') return {contents:'export const useRouter=()=>({push:url=>location.assign(url),refresh:()=>location.reload(),replace:url=>location.replace(url)});',loader:'js'};
+      const original=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'dashboard',args.path.slice(2)+'.ts'),'utf8');
+      const names=[...original.matchAll(/export\s+(?:async\s+)?function\s+(\w+)/g)].map(m=>m[1]);
+      return {contents:names.map(name=>`export const ${name}=async()=>{throw new Error("Fake browser actions must not run")};`).join('\n'),loader:'js'};
+    });
+  }}]});
+  const requests=[],errors=[],blocked=[];
+  const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{
+    requests.push(req.method+' '+req.url);
+    if(req.url.startsWith('/api/jobs/')) {res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify({description:null,descriptionIsSaved:false,currentDescription:'Current employer JD',currentQuestions:{questions:[{label:'Current employer question',required:false,fields:[{name:'current',type:'input_text',options:[]}]}]},questions:null}));return;}
+    if(req.url.startsWith('/api/')) {res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');res.end('{}');return;}
+    const filename=req.url==='/entry.js'?'entry.js':req.url==='/entry.css'?'entry.css':null;
+    if(filename){res.setHeader('Content-Type',filename.endsWith('css')?'text/css':'application/javascript');res.end(fs.readFileSync(path.join(output,filename)));return;}
+    res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/html');res.end('<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/entry.css"></head><body><div id="root"></div><script src="/entry.js"></script></body></html>');
+  });
+  await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));
+  const port=server.address().port,base=`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
+  let browser;
+  try {
+    browser=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',headless:true,args:['--no-sandbox']});
+    const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1280,height:800}});
+    page.setDefaultTimeout(5000);page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(10000);
+    page.on('pageerror',error=>{errors.push(error.message);console.error('Browser page error: '+error.message);});
+    await page.route('**/*',route=>{const url=new URL(route.request().url());if(url.origin!==base){blocked.push(url.origin);return route.abort();}return route.continue();});
+    const assertions=[];
+    const check=async(name,callback)=>{await callback();assertions.push(name);};
+    await page.goto(base+'/board?historyPage=1');
+    await page.getByRole('button',{name:'History',exact:true}).click();
+    await check('selected history page has two distinct fixture rows',()=>expect(page.locator('.rf-job-card__title')).toHaveCount(2));
+    await check('discovery-page rows excluded from history',()=>expect(page.locator('.rf-job-card__title').filter({hasText:'Discovery page one'})).toHaveCount(0));
+    await check('history page-local total agrees',()=>expect(page.locator('.rf-board-result-count')).toHaveText('2 of 2 roles'));
+    await check('server history pagination retained',()=>expect(page.getByText(/1000 saved jobs · Page 2/)).toBeVisible());
+    await check('applied count is one on this page',()=>expect(page.getByRole('radio',{name:'Applied · 1'})).toBeVisible());
+    await page.screenshot({path:path.join(dir,'history.png'),fullPage:true});
+    await page.getByRole('button',{name:/Retained prepared role/}).click();
+    await check('unscored prepared status visible',()=>expect(page.getByText('Prepared application',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await check('retained résumé visible',()=>expect(page.getByText('Retained résumé summary',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await check('retained cover letter visible',()=>expect(page.getByText('Retained cover letter body',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await page.screenshot({path:path.join(dir,'prepared-status.png'),fullPage:true});
+    await page.getByRole('button',{name:/Application questions/}).click();
+    await check('orphan saved answer retained',()=>expect(page.getByText('Retained historical answer',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await check('orphan historical question retained',()=>expect(page.getByText('Historical orphan question',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await check('honest unknown historical schema',()=>expect(page.getByText(/historical question schema is unavailable/)).toHaveCount(1));
+    await page.getByText('Saved application description',{exact:true}).click();
+    await check('immutable saved JD visible',()=>expect(page.getByText('Immutable application JD',{exact:true})).toBeVisible());
+    await check('unscored generation controls absent',()=>expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:/Regenerate|Re-prefill|Generate résumé|Generate cover letter|Generation instructions/})).toHaveCount(0));
+    await page.getByText('Immutable application JD',{exact:true}).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.screenshot({path:path.join(dir,'prepared.png'),fullPage:true});
+    await page.getByRole('radio',{name:'Applied · 1'}).click();
+    await check('applied view is selected history subset',()=>expect(page.locator('.rf-job-card__title')).toHaveText(['Retained applied role']));
+    await check('applied page-local count agrees',()=>expect(page.locator('.rf-board-result-count')).toHaveText('1 of 1 roles'));
+    await page.getByRole('button',{name:/Retained applied role/}).click();
+    await check('unscored persisted applied status visible',()=>expect(page.getByText('Applied · you',{exact:false})).toBeVisible());
+    await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});
+    await check('retained applied role on mobile',()=>expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Retained applied role',level:1})).toBeVisible());
+    await page.screenshot({path:path.join(dir,'applied-mobile.png'),fullPage:true});
+    if(errors.length||blocked.length) throw new Error(JSON.stringify({errors,blocked}));
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'result.json'),JSON.stringify({browser:browser.version(),target:'owned random loopback port',boundaries:'fake authenticated props/actions/navigation/API; actual RolefitBoard and descendants; read-only UI interactions',assertions,requests,errors,blocked},null,2));
+    console.log('PASS: '+assertions.length+' assertions, disjoint history/applied pools and unscored retained application content/status; Chromium '+browser.version());
+  } finally {if(browser) await browser.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));}
+})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});

(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id']) IS DISTINCT FROM\n    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id'])\n OR OLD.approved_at>clock_timestamp() OR text, n jsonb, o jsonb', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.operational_update(t text, n jsonb, o jsonb)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO fields:=ARRAY['last_attempt_at','last_complete_success_at','last_outcome','next_due_at','failure_streak','suspicious_empty_streak'];\n ELSIF t='source_listings' THEN lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(l.source_account_id) LIMIT 1;\n  fields:=ARRAY['closed_at'];\n ELSE RETURN false;\n END IF;\n IF sid IS NULL OR NOT lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(sid) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n IF t='source_accounts' AND n->>'last_outcome' NOT IN ('attempting','complete','partial','failed','suspicious_empty') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid bounded source outcome'; END IF;\n IF n-fields IS DISTINCT FROM o-fields THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational update exceeds fixed field allowlist'; END IF;\n IF t='source_listings' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_operational_listings WHERE listing_id=(n->>'id')::uuid) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational listing not preallocated'; END IF;\n UPDATE lifecycle_private.preserve_archive_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF TG_OP='TRUNCATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive pending/history cannot be truncated'; END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('public_archive_items','public_archive_receipts','public_archive_batches') AND EXISTS(\n  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batch_markers m WHERE m.batch_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'batch_id')::uuid\n   AND m.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND OLD.state='superseded' AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n   AND s.replaced_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_items' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND s.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n    AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND b.state='claimed' AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n    AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id\n      AND e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  IF NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'canonical_event')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'canonical_event') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n   WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='acked' AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending membership';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF OLD.state IN ('acked','superseded') AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal archive state immutable'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.state='superseded' AND OLD.state<>'superseded' AND NOT EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n    AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.eligible_until<=lifecycle_private.archive_clock()) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit consumed archive replacement authorization required'; END IF;\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable batch membership and seal clock'; END IF;\n  IF OLD.state<>'claimed' AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable persisted seal'; END IF;\n  IF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD OR OLD.state='sealed' AND NEW.state='claimed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive state cannot move backward'; END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('public_outbox','public_change_requirements') THEN\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_outbox' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c\n    JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r fencing before cleanup'; END IF;\n  RETURN OLD;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (OLD.id<>NEW.id OR OLD.owner_token<>NEW.owner_token OR OLD.generation<>NEW.generation\n  OR OLD.claim_kind<>NEW.claim_kind OR OLD.claim_id<>NEW.claim_id) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'reservation claim identity is immutable'; END IF;\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.state<>'held' AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'subject_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'subject_id') THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal reservation cannot resurrect or change'; END IF;\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.state<>'held' THEN\n  IF NEW.subject_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subject_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal reservation owner cannot change'; END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE kind=NEW.claim_kind AND work_id=NEW.claim_id;\n IF NEW.state='fenced' THEN\n  IF c.generation<=NEW.generation OR c.replay_floor<NEW.generation THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'reservation release requires fenced generation'; END IF;\n ELSIF TG_OP='INSERT' OR NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN\n  IF c.owner_token<>NEW.owner_token OR c.generation<>NEW.generation OR c.state<>'active'\n   OR c.generation<=c.replay_floor OR c.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale, expired or fenced capacity claim'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.state='settled' AND (NEW.backend_pid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_backend_pid() OR NEW.transaction_id IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement requires current backend transaction'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF NEW.state='held' AND NEW.backend_pid IS NOT NULL THEN\n  IF c.reservation_subject_bound AND c.reservation_subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'capacity claim already bound to another subject owner'; END IF;\n  IF c.subject_id IS NOT NULL AND c.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'capacity subject differs from claim owner'; END IF;\n  IF NOT c.reservation_subject_bound THEN\n   UPDATE public.lifecycle_claims SET reservation_subject_bound=true,reservation_subject_id=NEW.subject_id\n    WHERE kind=c.kind AND work_id=c.work_id;\n  END IF;\n END IF;\n IF NEW.state='held' THEN\n  SELECT pg_database_size(current_database())+COALESCE(sum(bytes),0)+NEW.bytes INTO allocated\n  FROM public.capacity_reservations 'lifecycle_staging_fence', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_staging_fence()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE e public.source_enumerations; c public.lifecycle_claims; floor bigint;\nBEGIN\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_accounts' THEN\n  IF NEW.replay_floor<OLD.replay_floor OR NEW.enumeration_sequence<OLD.enumeration_sequence OR NEW.claim_generation<OLD.claim_generation THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'source generation and replay floor are monotonic'; END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN e:=NEW;\n ELSE SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM public.source_enumerations WHERE id=NEW.enumeration_id;\n END IF;\n SELECT replay_floor INTO STRICT floor FROM public.source_accounts WHERE id=e.source_id;\n IF e.sequence<=floor THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'enumeration sequence rejected by replay floor'; END IF;\n SELECT * INTO c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE kind='source' AND work_id=e.source_id::text\n AND owner_token=e.owner_token AND generation=e.generation AND generation>replay_floor\n AND state='active' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND invoking_role=current_user\n AND subject_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id();\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale, foreign or fenced enumeration claim'; END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='enumeration_members' AND e.status<>'running' THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed or terminal membership cannot change';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='reconciliation_checkpoints' THEN\n  IF NEW.generation<>e.generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale checkpoint claim'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n   IF NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.source_id<>OLD.source_id OR NEW.sequence<>OLD.sequence THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'enumeration identity is immutable';\n   END IF;\n   IF OLD.status='complete' AND NEW.status<>'complete' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed enumeration status is immutable';\n   END IF;\n   IF NEW.owner_token<>OLD.owner_token OR NEW.generation<>OLD.generation THEN\n    -- The current same-source claim was validated above. A takeover fences its\n    -- old generation first; only ownership may change on an unfinished complete\n    -- snapshot. Completion/evidence identity and cursor are never reconstructed.\n    IF OLD.status<>'complete' OR OLD.reconciled_at IS NOT NULL\n       OR NEW.generation<=OLD.generation OR c.replay_floor<OLD.generation\n       OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'owner_token'-'generation') IS DISTINCT FROM\n          (to_jsonb(OLD)-'owner_token'-'generation') THEN\n     RAISE EXCEPTION 'only completed pending reconciliation permits ownership handoff';\n    END IF;\n   END IF;\n  END IF;\n END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.lifecycle_write_checks(invoking_role,subject_id,owner_token,generation)\n VALUES(current_user,public.app_user_id(),e.owner_token,e.generation);\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_stamp_consumption', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_stamp_consumption()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF NEW.consumed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consumed_at THEN\n  IF OLD.status<>'ready' OR OLD.job_version_id IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(OLD.description_snapshot),'') IS NULL THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'consumption requires durable ready snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  NEW.consumed_at:=clock_timestamp();\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_validate_row', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_validate_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; n jsonb; o jsonb; jid text; growth bigint:=0;\n payload text; oldpayload text; k text; vid text; owner_id uuid; protection boolean:=false;\n rid uuid; json_keys text[];\nBEGIN\n SELECT * INTO STRICT ctl FROM public.lifecycle_control WHERE singleton;\n n:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n o:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;\n jid:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN n->>'id' ELSE n->>'job_id' END;\n IF jid IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lifecycle:job:'||jid,0)); END IF;\n -- Task10 AFTER projection trigger and deferred exact pairing replace the old placeholder.\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') AND current_user NOT IN ('anon','authenticated') THEN\n  IF lifecycle_private.operational_update(TG_TABLE_NAME,n,o) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF ctl.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') AND TG_OP='DELETE' THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lean lifecycle identity deletion is disabled after cutover';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions') AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR\n   (TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND o->>'description' IS NOT NULL AND (n->>'description' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'description' OR n->>'description_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'description_version_id')) OR\n   (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_questions' AND (n->'questions' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'questions' OR n->>'job_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'job_version_id'))) THEN\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_reviews WHERE job_id=jid AND verdict='approve')\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.review_corrections WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.application_packages WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.resume_scores WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.cover_letter_edits WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.generation_jobs WHERE job_id=jid AND status IN ('pending','running'))\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_payload_demands WHERE job_id=jid AND status IN ('pending','running') AND COALESCE(lease_until,protection_until)>clock_timestamp())\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'job payload is protected'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n owner_id:=(n->>'user_id')::uuid;\n IF current_user='authenticated' AND owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign lifecycle owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n protection:=TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_reviews' AND n->>'verdict'='approve')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='generation_jobs' AND n->>'status' IN ('pending','running','ready'))\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready');\n IF protection THEN\n  vid:=n->>'job_version_id';\n  IF vid IS NULL OR (NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'kind'='questions') AND n->>'description_snapshot' IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(\n    SELECT FROM public.jobs WHERE id=jid AND description IS NOT NULL AND description_version_id::text=vid)) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'protection requires version-ready payload or durable snapshot'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready' AND n->>'kind'='questions'\n AND (n->'questions_snapshot' IS NULL OR n->'questions_snapshot'='null'::jsonb)\n AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_questions WHERE job_id=jid AND job_version_id::text=n->>'job_version_id') THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ready question demand requires version-ready questions or snapshot';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status' IN ('pending','running') THEN\n  IF COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz) IS NULL OR COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp()\n    OR COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)>clock_timestamp()+interval '180 seconds' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'active demand requires bounded database-time lease'; END IF;\n END IF;\n -- Payload fields are charged on every rewrite, including same-size replacements;\n -- a prior DELETE or shrink never supplies physical allocation credit.\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions','job_reviews','review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits','generation_jobs','job_payload_demands') THEN\n  -- Inspect actual declared types: JSON numeric/boolean/string scalars are\n  -- payload too. SQL numeric metadata is not confused with a JSON scalar.\n  SELECT array_agg(attname::text) INTO json_keys FROM pg_attribute\n   WHERE attrelid=TG_RELID AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped\n   AND atttypid IN ('jsonb'::regtype,'json'::regtype);\n  FOR k,payload IN SELECT key,value FROM jsonb_each_text(n) LOOP\n   oldpayload:=o->>k;\n   IF payload IS NOT NULL AND payload IS DISTINCT FROM oldpayload\n     AND (k=ANY(json_keys) AND n->k NOT IN ('{}'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k) IN ('object','array') AND payload NOT IN ('{}','[]')\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k)='string' AND\n       (octet_length(payload)>256 OR (k NOT IN (\n        'id','user_id','job_id','job_version_id','profile_version','verdict','stage1_decision',\n        'experience_match','confidence','work_arrangement','pay_period','status','kind',\n        'description_capture_provenance','capture_provenance','description_version_id',\n        'claim_owner_token','lease_until','protection_until') AND k NOT LIKE '%\\_at' ESCAPE '\\')))\n   THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(payload)*4+256; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF n IS DISTINCT FROM o THEN growth:=octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF growth>0 THEN\n  BEGIN rid:=NULLIF(current_setting('lifecycle.reservation',true),'')::uuid;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NOT NEW.archive_ever_activated THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation history is monotonic'; END IF;\n IF OLD.identity_migration_activated_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.identity_migration_activated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.identity_migration_activated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity migration activation is immutable'; END IF;\n IF NEW.activation_generation<OLD.activation_generation OR NEW.flags_version<OLD.flags_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control generation and schema version are monotonic'; END IF;\n IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'identity_migration_activated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'identity_migration_activated_at') AND NEW.activation_generation<=OLD.activation_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control changes require a newer activation generation'; END IF;\n IF NEW.safety_stage='enforced' AND OLD.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR (NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run) THEN\n  IF NOT (NEW.identity_enabled AND NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle activation requires compatible writer and backfill readiness'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retirement requires enforced lifecycle stage'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF OLD.safety_stage='enforced' AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe legacy rollback after cutover'; END IF;\n IF NEW.archive_stage<> 'never_activated' AND NOT OLD.archive_ever_activated OR NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation requires validated destination and producer readiness'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled AND NOT lifecycle_private.archive_baseline_ready() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive export requires completed bounded baseline'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NEW.archive_stage='active' AND OLD.archive_stage<>'active' THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive producer readiness unavailable'; was_paused boolean; req review_requests%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n IF uid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE user_id=uid) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign in' USING ERRCODE='42501';\n END IF;\n PERFORM 1 FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n -- Inspect stored pause/expiry, not the paid exemption: billing may have\n -- activated after the running worker already skipped this paused account.\n SELECT paused_at IS NOT NULL OR last_meaningful_at <= clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days'\n INTO was_paused FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid;\n UPDATE matching_activity SET last_meaningful_at=clock_timestamp(),paused_at=NULL WHERE user_id=uid;\n INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid)\n ON CONFLICT (user_id) WHERE review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') DO NOTHING\n RETURNING * INTO req;\n IF FOUND THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN; END IF;\n -- The worker might finish between conflict detection and this row lock. Retry\n -- insertion if so; never return a synthetic pending success without durable work.\n SELECT * INTO req FROM review_requests WHERE user_id=uid AND review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN\n   INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid) RETURNING * INTO req;\n   RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN;\n END IF;\n IF was_paused AND req.status='running' THEN\n   UPDATE review_requests SET resume_requested=true WHERE id=req.id;\n END IF;\n RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,true;\nEND\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=public, pg_temp'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'submit_feedback', 'arguments': 'p_kind text, p_message text', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_feedback(p_kind text, p_message text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE caller uuid := public.app_user_id();\nBEGIN\n PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n  IF caller IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;\n  -- A fresh post-lock snapshot prevents stale-snapshot rate bypasses.\n  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'read committed required' USING ERRCODE = '25000';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_kind IS NULL OR p_kind NOT IN ('issue','criticism','feature_request')\n     OR p_message IS NULL OR char_length(p_message) > 4000\n     OR p_message !~ '[^[:space:]]' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid feedback' USING ERRCODE = '22023';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('feedback:' || caller::text, 0));\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletions WHERE user_id = caller) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'account deleted' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n  END IF;\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.feedback WHERE user_id = caller\n      AND created_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour') >= 5 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feedback rate limit' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.feedback(user_id, kind, message) VALUES (caller, p_kind, btrim(p_message));\nEND;\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog, public'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'track_matching_activity', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.track_matching_activity()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE actor uuid := CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD.user_id ELSE NEW.user_id END;\nBEGIN\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='profiles' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN\n   INSERT INTO matching_activity(user_id) VALUES(NEW.user_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n ELSIF current_setting('role',true)='authenticated' AND actor=public.app_user_id()\n       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE user_id=actor) THEN\n   -- Preserve the expiry BEFORE advancing activity. THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical terminal retention not reached'; END IF;\n ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending critical event is immutable; slots never recycled automatically'; END IF;\n IF  OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->>'aggregate_type' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_type OR envelope->>'aggregate_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_id\n    OR (envelope->>'revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT EXCEPTION 'critical predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n  SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO total_count,total_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n  IF 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.require_public_change()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctl c.version_revision=(o->>'revision')::bigint) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n IF ctl.archive_stage<>'active' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive producer paused'; END IF;\n aid:=COALESCE(n,o)->>CASE WHEN THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational archive baseline not ready'; END IF;\n IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n  UPDATE public.public_archive_heads SET revision=revision+1 WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME AND aggregate_id=aid RETURNING revision INTO rev;\n ELSE\n INSERT INTO public.public_archive_heads VALUES(TG_TABLE_NAME,aid,1)\n ON CONFLICT(aggregate_type,aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=public.public_archive_heads.revision+1 RETURNING revision INTO rev;\n END IF;\n k:=CASE WHEN rev=1 THEN 'baseline' WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN 'removed'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND n->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NULL THEN 'closed'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND n->>'closed_at' IS NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL THEN 'reopened'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND n->>'source_availability'='closed' AND o->>'source_availability'<>'closed' THEN 'closed'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND n->>'source_availability'='open' AND o->>'source_availability'='closed' THEN 'reopened'\n  ELSE 'upsert' END;\n raw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n oldraw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;\n observed:=NULLIF(raw->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN\n  IF k='closed' THEN observed:=(raw->>'closed_at')::timestamptz;\n  ELSIF raw->>'last_seen_at' IS DISTINCT FROM oldraw->>'last_seen_at' THEN\n   observed:=(raw->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz;\n  ELSIF k='reopened' THEN observed:=(SELECT successful_last_observed_at FROM public.source_listings WHERE job_id=aid ORDER BY successful_last_observed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1);\n  END IF;\n ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' THEN\n  IF raw->>'successful_last_observed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM oldraw->>'successful_last_observed_at' THEN\n   observed:=(raw->>'successful_last_observed_at')::timestamptz;\n  ELSIF raw->>'content_changed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM oldraw->>'content_changed_at' THEN\n   observed:=(raw->>'content_changed_at')::timestamptz;\n  ELSIF k='closed' AND sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n   observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM public.lifecycle_operational_sources WHERE source_id=sid);\n  ELSIF k='closed' THEN observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM public.source_enumerations WHERE id=(raw->>'last_miss_enumeration_id')::uuid);\n  END IF;\n END IF;\n provenance_value:=CASE WHEN observed IS NOT NULL THEN 'source_observation' WHEN k='baseline' THEN 'current_baseline' ELSE 'database_change' END;\n IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n  IF k NOT IN ('closed','reopened') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'only critical closure/reopen uses operational event slots'; END IF;\n  SELECT slot INTO slot_id FROM public.public_critical_event_slots WHERE state='free' ORDER BY slot LIMIT 1;\n  IF slot_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical operational event slots exhausted'; END IF;\n  UPDATE public.public_critical_event_slots SET state='allocated',transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id(),source_id=sid,\n   aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME,aggregate_id=aid,revision=rev,kind=k,body=COALESCE(n,o),occurred_at=clock_timestamp(),recorded_at=clock_timestamp(),observed_at=observed,provenance=provenance_value\n   WHERE slot=slot_id;\n  RETURN NULL;\n END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.public_change_requirements(aggregate_type,aggregate_id,revision,kind,body,observed_at,provenance)\n     THEN p_legacy_closed_at IS NOT NULL\n    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.source_listings l WHERE l.job_id=p_job_id AND l.source_availability<>'closed') THEN true\n    WHEN NOT (ctl.feed_enabled OR ctl.source_enabled) THEN p_legacy_closed_at IS NOT NULL\n    ELSE false END\n  FROM public.lifecycle_control ctl WHERE ctl.singleton\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog, public'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_staging_fence', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_staging_fence()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE e public.source_enumerations; c public.lifecycle_claims; floor bigint;\nBEGIN\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_accounts' THEN\n  IF NEW.replay_floor<OLD.replay_floor OR NEW.enumeration_sequence<OLD.enumeration_sequence OR NEW.claim_generation<OLD.claim_generation THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'source generation and replay floor are monotonic'; END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN e:=NEW;\n ELSE SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM public.source_enumerations WHERE id=NEW.enumeration_id;\n END IF;\n SELECT replay_floor INTO STRICT floor FROM public.source_accounts WHERE id=e.source_id;\n IF e.sequence<=floor THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'enumeration sequence rejected by replay floor'; END IF;\n SELECT * INTO c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE kind='source' AND work_id=e.source_id::text\n AND owner_token=e.owner_token AND generation=e.generation AND generation>replay_floor\n AND state='active' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND invoking_role=current_user\n AND subject_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id();\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale, foreign or fenced enumeration claim'; END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='enumeration_members' AND e.status<>'running' THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed or terminal membership cannot change';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='reconciliation_checkpoints' THEN\n  IF NEW.generation<>e.generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale checkpoint claim'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n   IF NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.source_id<>OLD.source_id OR NEW.sequence<>OLD.sequence THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'enumeration identity is immutable';\n   END IF;\n   IF OLD.status='complete' AND NEW.status<>'complete' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed enumeration status is immutable';\n   END IF;\n   IF NEW.owner_token<>OLD.owner_token OR NEW.generation<>OLD.generation THEN\n    -- The current same-source claim was validated above. A takeover fences its\n    -- old generation first; only ownership may change on an unfinished complete\n    -- snapshot. Completion/evidence identity and cursor are never reconstructed.\n    IF OLD.status<>'complete' OR OLD.reconciled_at IS NOT NULL\n       OR NEW.generation<=OLD.generation OR c.replay_floor<OLD.generation\n       OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'owner_token'-'generation') IS DISTINCT FROM\n          (to_jsonb(OLD)-'owner_token'-'generation') THEN\n     RAISE EXCEPTION 'only completed pending reconciliation permits ownership handoff';\n    END IF;\n   END IF;\n  END IF;\n END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.lifecycle_write_checks(invoking_role,subject_id,owner_token,generation)\n VALUES(current_user,public.app_user_id(),e.owner_token,e.generation);\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_stamp_consumption', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_stamp_consumption()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF NEW.consumed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consumed_at THEN\n  IF OLD.status<>'ready' OR OLD.job_version_id IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(OLD.description_snapshot),'') IS NULL THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'consumption requires durable ready snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  NEW.consumed_at:=clock_timestamp();\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_validate_row', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_validate_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; n jsonb; o jsonb; jid text; growth bigint:=0;\n payload text; oldpayload text; k text; vid text; owner_id uuid; protection boolean:=false;\n rid uuid; json_keys text[];\nBEGIN\n SELECT * INTO STRICT ctl FROM public.lifecycle_control WHERE singleton;\n n:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n o:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;\n jid:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN n->>'id' ELSE n->>'job_id' END;\n IF jid IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lifecycle:job:'||jid,0)); END IF;\n -- Task10 AFTER projection trigger and deferred exact pairing replace the old placeholder.\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') AND current_user NOT IN ('anon','authenticated') THEN\n  IF lifecycle_private.operational_update(TG_TABLE_NAME,n,o) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF ctl.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') AND TG_OP='DELETE' THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lean lifecycle identity deletion is disabled after cutover';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions') AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR\n   (TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND o->>'description' IS NOT NULL AND (n->>'description' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'description' OR n->>'description_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'description_version_id')) OR\n   (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_questions' AND (n->'questions' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'questions' OR n->>'job_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'job_version_id'))) THEN\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_reviews WHERE job_id=jid AND verdict='approve')\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.review_corrections WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.application_packages WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.resume_scores WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.cover_letter_edits WHERE job_id=jid)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.generation_jobs WHERE job_id=jid AND status IN ('pending','running'))\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_payload_demands WHERE job_id=jid AND status IN ('pending','running') AND COALESCE(lease_until,protection_until)>clock_timestamp())\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'job payload is protected'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n owner_id:=(n->>'user_id')::uuid;\n IF current_user='authenticated' AND owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign lifecycle owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n protection:=TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_reviews' AND n->>'verdict'='approve')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='generation_jobs' AND n->>'status' IN ('pending','running','ready'))\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready');\n IF protection THEN\n  vid:=n->>'job_version_id';\n  IF vid IS NULL OR (NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'kind'='questions') AND n->>'description_snapshot' IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(\n    SELECT FROM public.jobs WHERE id=jid AND description IS NOT NULL AND description_version_id::text=vid)) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'protection requires version-ready payload or durable snapshot'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready' AND n->>'kind'='questions'\n AND (n->'questions_snapshot' IS NULL OR n->'questions_snapshot'='null'::jsonb)\n AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_questions WHERE job_id=jid AND job_version_id::text=n->>'job_version_id') THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ready question demand requires version-ready questions or snapshot';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status' IN ('pending','running') THEN\n  IF COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz) IS NULL OR COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp()\n    OR COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)>clock_timestamp()+interval '180 seconds' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'active demand requires bounded database-time lease'; END IF;\n END IF;\n -- Payload fields are charged on every rewrite, including same-size replacements;\n -- a prior DELETE or shrink never supplies physical allocation credit.\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions','job_reviews','review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits','generation_jobs','job_payload_demands') THEN\n  -- Inspect actual declared types: JSON numeric/boolean/string scalars are\n  -- payload too. SQL numeric metadata is not confused with a JSON scalar.\n  SELECT array_agg(attname::text) INTO json_keys FROM pg_attribute\n   WHERE attrelid=TG_RELID AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped\n   AND atttypid IN ('jsonb'::regtype,'json'::regtype);\n  FOR k,payload IN SELECT key,value FROM jsonb_each_text(n) LOOP\n   oldpayload:=o->>k;\n   IF payload IS NOT NULL AND payload IS DISTINCT FROM oldpayload\n     AND (k=ANY(json_keys) AND n->k NOT IN ('{}'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k) IN ('object','array') AND payload NOT IN ('{}','[]')\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k)='string' AND\n       (octet_length(payload)>256 OR (k NOT IN (\n        'id','user_id','job_id','job_version_id','profile_version','verdict','stage1_decision',\n        'experience_match','confidence','work_arrangement','pay_period','status','kind',\n        'description_capture_provenance','capture_provenance','description_version_id',\n        'claim_owner_token','lease_until','protection_until') AND k NOT LIKE '%\\_at' ESCAPE '\\')))\n   THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(payload)*4+256; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF n IS DISTINCT FROM o THEN growth:=octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF growth>0 THEN\n  BEGIN rid:=NULLIF(current_setting('lifecycle.reservation',true),'')::uuid;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END;\n END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.lifecycle_write_checks(invoking_role,subject_id,reservation_id,job_id,scope,bytes,row_count)\n VALUES(current_user,public.app_user_id(),rid,jid,TG_TABLE_NAME,growth,1);\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'matching_paused', 'arguments': 'uid uuid', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.matching_paused(uid uuid)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n SELECT NOT EXISTS (\n   SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.user_id=uid AND s.plan IN ('standard','pro')\n     AND s.status='active' AND nullif(s.stripe_subscription_id,'') IS NOT NULL\n     AND s.current_period_end + interval '3 days' > clock_timestamp()\n ) AND EXISTS (\n   SELECT 1 FROM matching_activity a WHERE a.user_id=uid\n     AND (a.paused_at IS NOT NULL OR a.last_meaningful_at <= clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days')\n )\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=public, pg_temp'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'preserve_lifecycle_control', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_lifecycle_control()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle control history cannot be removed'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NOT NEW.archive_ever_activated THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation history is monotonic'; END IF;\n IF OLD.identity_migration_activated_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.identity_migration_activated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.identity_migration_activated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity migration activation is immutable'; END IF;\n IF NEW.activation_generation<OLD.activation_generation OR NEW.flags_version<OLD.flags_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control generation and schema version are monotonic'; END IF;\n IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'identity_migration_activated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'identity_migration_activated_at') AND NEW.activation_generation<=OLD.activation_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control changes require a newer activation generation'; END IF;\n IF NEW.safety_stage='enforced' AND OLD.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR (NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run) THEN\n  IF NOT (NEW.identity_enabled AND NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle activation requires compatible writer and backfill readiness'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retirement requires enforced lifecycle stage'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF OLD.safety_stage='enforced' AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe legacy rollback after cutover'; END IF;\n IF NEW.archive_stage<> 'never_activated' AND NOT OLD.archive_ever_activated OR NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation requires validated destination and producer readiness'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled AND NOT lifecycle_private.archive_baseline_ready() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive export requires completed bounded baseline'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NEW.archive_stage='active' AND OLD.archive_stage<>'active' THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive producer readiness unavailable'; END IF;\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'resume_matching', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resume_matching()\n RETURNS TABLE(status text, existing boolean)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE uid uuid := public.app_user_id(); was_paused boolean; req review_requests%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n IF uid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE user_id=uid) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign in' USING ERRCODE='42501';\n END IF;\n PERFORM 1 FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n -- Inspect stored pause/expiry, not the paid exemption: billing may have\n -- activated after the running worker already skipped this paused account.\n SELECT paused_at IS NOT NULL OR last_meaningful_at <= clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days'\n INTO was_paused FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid;\n UPDATE matching_activity SET last_meaningful_at=clock_timestamp(),paused_at=NULL WHERE user_id=uid;\n INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid)\n ON CONFLICT (user_id) WHERE review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') DO NOTHING\n RETURNING * INTO req;\n IF FOUND THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN; END IF;\n -- The worker might finish between conflict detection and this row lock. Retry\n -- insertion if so; never return a synthetic pending success without durable work.\n SELECT * INTO req FROM review_requests WHERE user_id=uid AND review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN\n   INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid) RETURNING * INTO req;\n   RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN;\n END IF;\n IF was_paused AND req.status='running' THEN\n   UPDATE review_requests SET resume_requested=true WHERE id=req.id;\n END IF;\n RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,true;\nEND\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=public, pg_temp'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'submit_feedback', 'arguments': 'p_kind text, p_message text', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_feedback(p_kind text, p_message text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE caller uuid := public.app_user_id();\nBEGIN\n PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n  IF caller IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;\n  -- A fresh post-lock snapshot prevents stale-snapshot rate bypasses.\n  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'read committed required' USING ERRCODE = '25000';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_kind IS NULL OR p_kind NOT IN ('issue','criticism','feature_request')\n     OR p_message IS NULL OR char_length(p_message) > 4000\n     OR p_message !~ '[^[:space:]]' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid feedback' USING ERRCODE = '22023';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('feedback:' || caller::text, 0));\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletions WHERE user_id = caller) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'account deleted' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n  END IF;\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.feedback WHERE user_id = caller\n      AND created_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour') >= 5 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feedback rate limit' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.feedback(user_id, kind, message) VALUES (caller, p_kind, btrim(p_message));\nEND;\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog, public'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'track_matching_activity', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.track_matching_activity()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE actor uuid := CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD.user_id ELSE NEW.user_id END;\nBEGIN\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='profiles' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN\n   INSERT INTO matching_activity(user_id) VALUES(NEW.user_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n ELSIF current_setting('role',true)='authenticated' AND actor=public.app_user_id()\n       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE user_id=actor) THEN\n   -- Preserve the expiry BEFORE advancing activity. Only explicit resume clears it.\n   UPDATE matching_activity SET\n     paused_at=CASE WHEN public.matching_paused(actor) THEN coalesce(paused_at,clock_timestamp()) ELSE paused_at END,\n     last_meaningful_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE user_id=actor;\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND\n$function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=public, pg_temp'], 'prosecdef': True, 'proacl': +E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_baseline_ready',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_baseline_ready()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS boolean\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       ' STABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE t text; key text; missing boolean;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' FOREACH t IN ARRAY '
+E                       "ARRAY['jobs','source_accounts','source_listings','job_versions','companies','locations',\n"
+E                       '  '
+E                       "'brands','skills','company_brands','company_sources','job_locations','job_skills','identity_assertions'] "
+E                       'LOOP\n'
+E                       "  key:=CASE WHEN t='locations' THEN 'raw' ELSE 'id' END;\n"
+E                       "  EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.%I t WHERE NOT "
+E                       'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_heads h WHERE '
+E                       "h.aggregate_type=$1 AND h.aggregate_id=t.%I::text))',t,key) INTO "
+E                       'missing USING t;\n'
+E                       '  IF missing THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' END LOOP;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN true;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_budget_bytes',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS bigint\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' STABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT\n'
+E                       ' COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,NULL,2048)) FROM '
+E                       'public.public_change_requirements),0)\n'
+E                       ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)\n'
+E                       '   +lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(canonical_event)) '
+E                       'FROM public.public_outbox),0)\n'
+E                       ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)\n'
+E                       "   +CASE WHEN state='pending' THEN "
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(canonical_event) ELSE '
+E                       '0 END)\n'
+E                       '   FROM public.public_critical_event_slots WHERE state IN '
+E                       "('allocated','pending')),0)\n"
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_clock',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.archive_clock()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS timestamp with time zone\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$ SELECT clock_timestamp() $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_destination_ready',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS boolean\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' STABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_destination\n'
+E                       '  WHERE singleton AND validated_at<=clock_timestamp() AND '
+E                       'private_validated AND encryption_validated\n'
+E                       '  AND policy_validated AND length(btrim(validation_evidence))>0\n'
+E                       "  AND bucket ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$' AND bucket "
+E                       "NOT LIKE '%..%' AND bucket !~ '^[0-9.]+$'\n"
+E                       "  AND region ~ '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-[0-9]$' AND expected_owner ~ "
+E                       "'^[0-9]{12}$'\n"
+E                       '  AND length(object_prefix)<=256 AND object_prefix ~ '
+E                       "'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$')\n"
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_live_bytes',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_live_bytes()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS bigint\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' STABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT\n'
+E                       ' COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,NULL,2048)) FROM '
+E                       'public.public_change_requirements),0)\n'
+E                       ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)) '
+E                       'FROM public.public_outbox),0)\n'
+E                       ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)) '
+E                       'FROM public.public_critical_event_slots WHERE state IN '
+E                       "('allocated','pending')),0)\n"
+E                       ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+E                       'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(NULL,i.canonical_event,1024)) '
+E                       'FROM public.public_archive_items i JOIN '
+E                       'public.public_archive_batches b USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+E                       "b.state<>'acked'),0)\n"
+E                       " +COALESCE((SELECT sum(8192+CASE WHEN state='sealed' THEN "
+E                       '4096+2::bigint*manifest_bytes ELSE 0 END) FROM '
+E                       "public.public_archive_batches WHERE state<>'acked'),0)\n"
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_processing_charge',
+E                       'arguments': 'canonical bytea',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(canonical bytea)\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS bigint\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' IMMUTABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT 6::bigint*COALESCE(octet_length(canonical),0)+128000\n'
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'archive_row_charge',
+E                       'arguments': 'body jsonb, canonical bytea, overhead integer',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body jsonb, canonical bytea, '
+E                       'overhead integer)\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS bigint\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' IMMUTABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT '
+E                       '2::bigint*(COALESCE(octet_length(body::text),0)+COALESCE(octet_length(canonical),0))+overhead\n'
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'consume_archive_authorization',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.consume_archive_authorization()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive authorization "
+E                       "cannot be deleted or truncated'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF OLD.consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.consumed_at IS NULL OR '
+E                       'NEW.replacement_batch_id IS NULL\n'
+E                       " OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id']) "
+E                       'IS DISTINCT FROM\n'
+E                       "    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id'])\n"
+E                       ' OR OLD.approved_at>clock_timestamp() OR '
+E                       'OLD.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()\n'
+E                       ' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b WHERE '
+E                       'b.batch_id=NEW.replacement_batch_id\n'
+E                       "  AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND b.state='claimed') THEN\n"
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid archive authorization consumption'; "
+E                       'END IF;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'operational_receipt_valid',
+E                       'arguments': 'sid uuid',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(sid uuid)\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS boolean\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       ' STABLE\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_operational_receipts '
+E                       'r JOIN public.lifecycle_claims c\n'
+E                       " ON c.kind='source' AND c.work_id=r.source_id::text AND "
+E                       'c.owner_token=r.owner_token AND c.generation=r.generation\n'
+E                       ' WHERE r.source_id=sid AND r.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND '
+E                       'r.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()\n'
+E                       ' AND r.invoking_role=current_user AND r.subject_id IS NOT '
+E                       'DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id()\n'
+E                       ' AND c.invoking_role=r.invoking_role AND c.subject_id IS NOT '
+E                       'DISTINCT FROM r.subject_id\n'
+E                       " AND c.state='active' AND c.generation>c.replay_floor AND "
+E                       'c.lease_until>clock_timestamp())\n'
+E                       '$function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',

+E                       'DECLARE sid uuid; fields text[];\n'
