+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP='TRUNCATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive "

+E                       " IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "

+E                       'AND EXISTS(\n'
+E                       '  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batch_markers m WHERE '

+E                       's.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n'
+E                       "   AND s.replaced_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN "
+E                       'RETURN OLD; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_items' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n"
+E                       "  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND "
+E                       'EXISTS(\n'
+E                       '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n'
+E                       '   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON '
+E                       'a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n'
+E                       '   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON '
+E                       'b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n'
+E                       '   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND '
+E                       's.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n'
+E                       '    AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id AND a.consumed_at '

+E                       '    AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE '

+E                       'NEW; END IF;\n'
+E                       "  IF NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea AND "
+E                       "(to_jsonb(NEW)-'canonical_event')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'canonical_event') "
+E                       'AND EXISTS(\n'
+E                       '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b JOIN '
+E                       'public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n'
+E                       "   WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='acked' AND "
+E                       "b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN NEW; "
+E                       'END IF;\n'

+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' "

+E                       'OLD THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal archive state immutable'; END IF;\n"
+E                       "  IF NEW.state='superseded' AND OLD.state<>'superseded' AND NOT "
+E                       'EXISTS(\n'
+E                       '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n'
+E                       '   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON '
+E                       'a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n'
+E                       '   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND '
+E                       'a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n'
+E                       '    AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND '
+E                       'OLD.eligible_until<=lifecycle_private.archive_clock()) THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit consumed archive replacement "
+E                       "authorization required'; END IF;\n"
+E                       '  IF '
+E                       "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n"
+E                       '    IS DISTINCT FROM '
+E                       "(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) "
+E                       'THEN\n'

+E                       'END IF;\n'

+E                       '    IS DISTINCT FROM '

+E                       "THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable persisted seal'; END IF;\n"
+E                       "  IF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD OR "
+E                       "OLD.state='sealed' AND NEW.state='claimed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION "

+E                       '  RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "
+E                       "('public_outbox','public_change_requirements') THEN\n"
+E                       "  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_outbox' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM "
+E                       'public.public_archive_coverage c\n'
+E                       '    JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE '

+E                       'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_outbox WHERE '

+E                       'c.aggregate_id=OLD.aggregate_id AND c.revision=OLD.revision) THEN '
+E                       'RETURN OLD; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending event or archive history';\n"
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',

+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'preserve_operational_slot',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.preserve_operational_slot()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE envelope jsonb; total_count bigint; total_bytes bigint;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational slots "
+E                       "cannot be deleted or truncated'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF NEW.slot<>OLD.slot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational slot "
+E                       "identity immutable'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF OLD.state='free' AND NEW.state='allocated' THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF NOT '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) THEN '
+E                       "RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot requires operational receipt'; END "
+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       " ELSIF OLD.state='allocated' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF NOT '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) OR '
+E                       'NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id()\n'
+E                       '   OR '
+E                       "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) "
+E                       'IS DISTINCT FROM\n'
+E                       '      '
+E                       "(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) "
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event differs from allocated public "
+E                       "change'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " ELSIF OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state='acked' THEN\n"
+E                       "  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state') IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       "(to_jsonb(OLD)-'state') OR NOT EXISTS(\n"
+E                       '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN '
+E                       'public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+E                       'c.event_id=OLD.event_id) THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot ack requires exact durable "
+E                       "receipt'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " ELSIF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW.state='acked' AND "
+E                       "NEW.body='{}'::jsonb AND NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea\n"
+E                       '  AND '
+E                       "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event'])=(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event']) "
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       '  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN '
+E         -             'public.public_archive_batch_markers b USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+E         ?                                         ----- -                   ^^^^^^^
+E         +             'public.public_archive_batches b USING(batch_id)\n'
+E         ?                                                             ^^
+E         +             '    JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+E         -             'c.event_id=OLD.event_id\n'
+E         ?             ^                         ^
+E         +             "c.event_id=OLD.event_id AND b.state='acked'\n"
+E         ?             ^                       ++++++++++++++++++++  ^
+E                       "    AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN "
+E                       "RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical terminal retention not reached'; END "
+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       " ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending critical event is immutable; slots "
+E                       "never recycled automatically'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF NEW.state='pending' THEN\n"
+E                       "  envelope:=convert_from(NEW.canonical_event,'UTF8')::jsonb;\n"
+E                       "  IF envelope->>'event_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_id::text OR "
+E                       "envelope->'body' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.body\n"
+E         -             "    OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         ?                     -            ^^^ ^^^^^   --------------
+E         +             "    OR envelope->>'aggregate_type' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         ?                                 ^^^^ ^  ++++++
+E         -             "NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS "
+E         -             "DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS "
+E         -             "DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->>'aggregate_type' IS "
+E         -             "DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_type OR envelope->>'aggregate_id' IS "
+E         ?              --------------
+E         +             "NEW.aggregate_type OR envelope->>'aggregate_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         ?                                                                 ++++++++++++++
+E         -             'DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_id\n'
+E         ?              --------------
+E         +             'NEW.aggregate_id\n'
+E                       "    OR (envelope->>'revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       "NEW.revision OR envelope->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kind\n"
+E                       "    OR envelope->>'predecessor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       'NEW.predecessor_id::text OR '

+E                       'NEW.occurred_at THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event envelope differs from exact "

+E                       '  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE '

+E                       'WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id AND '

+E                       '    AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND '
+E                       "e.revision=NEW.revision-1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical "
+E                       "predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n"
+E         -             '  SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO '
+E         +             '  SELECT count(*),COALESCE(sum(octet_length(canonical_event)),0) '
+E         -             'total_count,total_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+E         +             'INTO total_count,total_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+E         ?              +++++
+E                       '  IF total_count+1>100000 OR '
+E         -             'total_bytes+2*octet_length(NEW.canonical_event)+lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(NEW.canonical_event)>134217728 '
+E         +             'total_bytes+octet_length(NEW.canonical_event)>134217728 THEN '
+E         -             "THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical outbox budget exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+E         ?              -----
+E         +             "RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical outbox budget exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [

+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '

+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF current_setting('role')='authenticated' AND OLD.user_id IS "
+E                       "DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign "
+E                       "lifecycle owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n"

+E                       'live service\n'

+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'demand removal requires fenced service claim'; "
+E                       'END IF;\n'

+E                       'DECLARE fields text[]; result jsonb;\n'

+E                       " WHEN 'company_sources' THEN "

+E                       " WHEN 'job_locations' THEN "

+E                       ' SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_backfill_readiness b\n'

+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; n jsonb; o jsonb; aid text; '
+E         -             'rev bigint; k text; sid uuid; slot_id integer; raw jsonb; oldraw '

+E         +             'rev bigint; k text; sid uuid; slot_id integer;\n'
+E         ?                                                            ^
+E         -             'jsonb; observed timestamptz; provenance_value text;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' SELECT * INTO STRICT ctl FROM public.lifecycle_control WHERE '

+E                       " n:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN NULL ELSE "

+E                       ' -- Safe local version retirement does not assert disappearance '

+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_versions' AND TG_OP='DELETE' AND EXISTS(\n"
+E                       '  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_version_coverage c WHERE '

+E                       " IF ctl.archive_stage<>'active' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive "

+E                       " aid:=COALESCE(n,o)->>CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='locations' THEN "

+E                       ' IF sid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM '
+E                       'public.public_archive_heads WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME '
+E                       'AND aggregate_id=aid) THEN\n'

+E                       ' IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+E                       '  UPDATE public.public_archive_heads SET revision=revision+1 '

+E                       ' INSERT INTO public.public_archive_heads '

+E                       ' ON CONFLICT(aggregate_type,aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET '
+E                       'revision=public.public_archive_heads.revision+1 RETURNING '
+E                       'revision INTO rev;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " k:=CASE WHEN rev=1 THEN 'baseline' WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN "
+E                       "'removed'\n"
+E                       "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND "
+E                       "n->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NULL THEN "
+E                       "'closed'\n"
+E                       "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND "
+E                       "n->>'closed_at' IS NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL THEN "
+E                       "'reopened'\n"
+E                       "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND "
+E                       "n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND "
+E                       "n->>'source_availability'='closed' AND "
+E                       "o->>'source_availability'<>'closed' THEN 'closed'\n"
+E                       "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND "
+E                       "n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND "
+E                       "n->>'source_availability'='open' AND "
+E                       "o->>'source_availability'='closed' THEN 'reopened'\n"
+E                       "  ELSE 'upsert' END;\n"
+E         -             " raw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE "
+E         -             'to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n'
+E         -             " oldraw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE "
+E         -             'to_jsonb(OLD) END;\n'
+E         -             " observed:=NULLIF(raw->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz;\n"
+E         -             " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN\n"
+E         -             "  IF k='closed' THEN observed:=(raw->>'closed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+E         -             "  ELSIF raw->>'last_seen_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         -             "oldraw->>'last_seen_at' THEN\n"
+E         -             "   observed:=(raw->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+E         -             "  ELSIF k='reopened' THEN observed:=(SELECT "
+E         -             'successful_last_observed_at FROM public.source_listings WHERE '
+E         -             'job_id=aid ORDER BY successful_last_observed_at DESC NULLS LAST '
+E         -             'LIMIT 1);\n'
+E         -             '  END IF;\n'
+E         -             " ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' THEN\n"
+E         -             "  IF raw->>'successful_last_observed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         -             "oldraw->>'successful_last_observed_at' THEN\n"
+E         -             "   observed:=(raw->>'successful_last_observed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+E         -             "  ELSIF raw->>'content_changed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         -             "oldraw->>'content_changed_at' THEN\n"
+E         -             "   observed:=(raw->>'content_changed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+E         -             "  ELSIF k='closed' AND sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n"
+E         -             '   observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM '
+E         -             'public.lifecycle_operational_sources WHERE source_id=sid);\n'
+E         -             "  ELSIF k='closed' THEN observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM "
+E         -             'public.source_enumerations WHERE '
+E         -             "id=(raw->>'last_miss_enumeration_id')::uuid);\n"
+E         -             '  END IF;\n'
+E         -             ' END IF;\n'
+E         -             ' provenance_value:=CASE WHEN observed IS NOT NULL THEN '
+E         -             "'source_observation' WHEN k='baseline' THEN 'current_baseline' "
+E         -             "ELSE 'database_change' END;\n"
+E                       ' IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+E                       "  IF k NOT IN ('closed','reopened') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'only "

+E                       '  SELECT slot INTO slot_id FROM '

+E         -             'aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME,aggregate_id=aid,revision=rev,kind=k,body=COALESCE(n,o),occurred_at=clock_timestamp(),recorded_at=clock_timestamp(),observed_at=observed,provenance=provenance_value\n'
+E         ?                                                                                                                                                              -------------------------------------------------
+E         +             'aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME,aggregate_id=aid,revision=rev,kind=k,body=COALESCE(n,o),occurred_at=clock_timestamp(),recorded_at=clock_timestamp()\n'

+E         ?                                                                                              -----------------------
+E         +             'public.public_change_requirements(aggregate_type,aggregate_id,revision,kind,body)\n'
+E         -             ' '

+E         ?                                                          --------------------------
+E         +             ' VALUES(TG_TABLE_NAME,aid,rev,k,COALESCE(n,o));\n'
+E         ?              +
+E                       ' RETURN NULL;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',

+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_archive_item',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.validate_archive_item()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE b public.public_archive_batches;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM public.public_archive_batches WHERE '
+E                       'batch_id=NEW.batch_id;\n'
+E                       " IF b.state<>'claimed' OR NEW.position>=b.event_count OR NOT "
+E                       'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e\n'
+E                       '  WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id AND '
+E                       'e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+E                       'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id\n'
+E                       '  AND e.revision=NEW.revision AND '
+E                       'e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event) THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'batch item must match exact unsealed pending "
+E                       "event'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_operational_receipt',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.validate_operational_receipt()\n'

+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'

+E                       "'^[[:space:]]*(COMMIT|END)([[:space:]]+(WORK|TRANSACTION))?[[:space:]]*;?[[:space:]]*$' "
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational receipt requires standalone "
+E                       "COMMIT'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF NOT '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) THEN '
+E                       "RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational receipt claim expired or fenced'; "
+E                       'END IF;\n'

+E                       "transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() AND state='allocated') THEN\n"
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational closure requires exact critical "

+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_operational_state',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.validate_operational_state()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE sid uuid;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'preallocated "
+E                       "operational identity cannot be deleted or truncated'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' sid:=NEW.source_id;\n'
+E                       ' IF sid<>OLD.source_id OR NOT '

+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational update requires same-source "

+E                       'IF;\n'

+E                       'proconfig': [

+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,

+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_outbox_insert',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+E                       'lifecycle_private.validate_outbox_insert()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE r public.public_change_requirements; usage_count bigint; '
+E                       'usage_bytes bigint; critical boolean; envelope jsonb;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' SELECT * INTO r FROM public.public_change_requirements WHERE '
+E                       'id=NEW.requirement_id AND transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id();\n'
+E                       ' IF NOT FOUND OR '
+E         -             '(r.aggregate_type,r.aggregate_id,r.revision,r.kind,r.body,r.occurred_at,r.observed_at,r.recorded_at,r.provenance)\n'
+E         ?                                                                                     -----------------------------------------
+E         +             '(r.aggregate_type,r.aggregate_id,r.revision,r.kind,r.body,r.occurred_at)\n'
+E                       ' IS DISTINCT FROM '
+E         -             '(NEW.aggregate_type,NEW.aggregate_id,NEW.revision,NEW.kind,NEW.body,NEW.occurred_at,NEW.observed_at,NEW.recorded_at,NEW.provenance) '
+E         ?                                                                                                 -----------------------------------------------
+E         +             '(NEW.aggregate_type,NEW.aggregate_id,NEW.revision,NEW.kind,NEW.body,NEW.occurred_at) '
+E                       'THEN\n'

+E                       "projection'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF (NEW.revision=1) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.predecessor_id IS '
+E                       "NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox predecessor inconsistent'; END "
+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       ' IF NEW.revision>1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM '
+E                       'public.public_pending_events e WHERE '
+E                       'e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id\n'
+E                       '   AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+E                       'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1)\n'
+E                       '  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage e '
+E                       'WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id\n'
+E                       '   AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+E                       'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1) '
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " envelope:=convert_from(NEW.canonical_event,'UTF8')::jsonb;\n"
+E                       " IF envelope->>'event_id'<>NEW.event_id::text OR "
+E                       "envelope->>'aggregate_type'<>NEW.aggregate_type\n"
+E                       " OR envelope->>'aggregate_id'<>NEW.aggregate_id OR "
+E                       "(envelope->>'revision')::bigint<>NEW.revision\n"
+E                       " OR envelope->>'predecessor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       "NEW.predecessor_id::text OR envelope->>'kind'<>NEW.kind\n"
+E         -             " OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E         -             "NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS "
+E         -             "DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS "
+E         -             "DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->'body'<>NEW.body OR "
+E         ?              ----------------------------
+E         +             " OR envelope->'body'<>NEW.body OR "
+E                       "(envelope->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<>NEW.occurred_at THEN\n"
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox canonical envelope differs'; END IF;\n"
+E         -             ' SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO '
+E         +             ' SELECT count(*),COALESCE(sum(octet_length(canonical_event)),0) '
+E         -             'usage_count,usage_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+E         +             'INTO usage_count,usage_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+E         ?              +++++
+E                       " critical:=NEW.kind IN ('closed','reopened');\n"

+E         +             ' OR usage_bytes+octet_length(NEW.canonical_event)>(CASE WHEN '
+E         -             ' OR '
+E         -             'usage_bytes+lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(NEW.body,NEW.canonical_event,2048)+lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(NEW.canonical_event)>(CASE '
+E         -             'WHEN critical THEN 134217728 ELSE 117440512 END) THEN\n'
+E         ?              -----
+E         +             'critical THEN 134217728 ELSE 117440512 END) THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'public outbox budget exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [
+E                           'search_path=pg_catalog',
+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_public_pair',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '

+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_outbox e WHERE '
+E                       'e.requirement_id=NEW.id\n'
+E                       '  AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+E                       'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision\n'
+E                       '  AND e.kind=NEW.kind AND e.body=NEW.body AND '

+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+E                       'proname': 'validate_write',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.validate_write()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE c public.lifecycle_claims; r '
+E                       'public.capacity_reservations; actor name;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' -- PostgreSQL lets any caller consume a deferred constraint '
+E                       'early. Only the\n'
+E                       ' -- actual top-level, standalone transaction boundary may run '
+E                       'this AFTER check.\n'
+E                       ' -- current_query() is server-provided, not a GUC. Fail closed '
+E                       'for comments,\n'
+E                       ' -- multi-statements, SET CONSTRAINTS, implicit/autocommit and '
+E                       'PREPARE TRANSACTION.\n'
+E                       ' -- Supported writers explicitly finish with COMMIT/END '
+E                       '[WORK|TRANSACTION].\n'
+E                       " IF TG_WHEN='AFTER' AND COALESCE(current_query(),'') !~* "
+E                       "'^[[:space:]]*(COMMIT|END)([[:space:]]+(WORK|TRANSACTION))?[[:space:]]*;?[[:space:]]*$' "
+E                       'THEN\n'

+E                       "or END validation';\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " -- role is PostgreSQL's actual SET ROLE state, not a "

+E                       "session_user ELSE current_setting('role') END;\n"

+E                       'NEW.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id()\n'
+E                       ' OR NEW.backend_pid<>pg_backend_pid() OR '
+E                       'NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id()) THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lifecycle invoking identity';\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' IF NEW.bytes>0 AND pg_database_size(current_database())+(SELECT '
+E                       'COALESCE(sum(bytes),0) FROM public.capacity_reservations WHERE '
+E                       "state='held')>6291456000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical capacity "
+E                       "budget exceeded'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF NEW.total_rows>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle admission "
+E                       "chunk exceeds 500 rows'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF NEW.bytes>0 AND NEW.reservation_id IS NULL THEN RAISE '
+E                       "EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF NEW.reservation_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+E                       '  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.capacity_reservations WHERE '
+E                       'id=NEW.reservation_id;\n'
+E                       "  IF NOT FOUND OR r.state NOT IN ('held','settled') OR "
+E                       'r.backend_pid<>NEW.backend_pid OR '
+E                       'r.transaction_id<>NEW.transaction_id\n'
+E                       '   OR r.invoking_role<>NEW.invoking_role OR r.subject_id IS '
+E                       'DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id\n'
+E                       '   OR r.job_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.job_id OR r.scope IS DISTINCT '
+E                       'FROM NEW.scope OR r.bytes<NEW.total_bytes\n'
+E                       "   OR r.backend_pid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid "
+E                       "capacity reservation owner, scope or budget'; END IF;\n"
+E                       '  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE '
+E                       'kind=r.claim_kind AND work_id=r.claim_id;\n'
+E                       '  IF NOT FOUND OR c.owner_token<>r.owner_token OR '
+E                       'c.generation<>r.generation THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale or fenced capacity claim'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' ELSIF NEW.owner_token IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+E                       '  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE '
+E                       'owner_token=NEW.owner_token AND generation=NEW.generation;\n'
+E                       '  IF NOT FOUND OR c.invoking_role<>NEW.invoking_role OR '
+E                       'c.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale or foreign lifecycle claim'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' ELSE RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF c.state<>'active' OR c.generation<=c.replay_floor OR "
+E                       'c.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN\n'

+E                       'NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id() OR\n'

+E                       'BEGIN\n'

+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       '  SELECT CASE\n'
+E                       '    -- Missing mappings retain honest legacy behavior; rollout '
+E                       'requires mapping readiness.\n'
+E                       '    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.source_listings l WHERE '
+E                       'l.job_id=p_job_id)\n'

+E                       'false\n'
+E                       '    WHEN NOT (ctl.feed_enabled OR ctl.source_enabled) THEN '
+E                       'p_legacy_closed_at IS NULL\n'

+E                       'l.job_id=p_job_id\n'

+E                       "l.source_availability='open')))\n"
+E                       '    END\n'

+E                       '$function$\n',

+E                       ' RETURNS void\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE jid text;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n'
+E                       ' -- Service erasure prelocks the entire owner Job set before '
+E                       'claim/child rows.\n'
+E                       ' FOR jid IN SELECT job_id FROM (\n'
+E                       '  SELECT job_id FROM public.job_reviews WHERE user_id=target\n'
+E                       '  UNION SELECT job_id FROM public.review_corrections WHERE '
+E                       'user_id=target\n'

+E                       'user_id=target\n'

+E                       'subject_id=target\n'

+E                       'LOOP\n'
+E                       '  PERFORM '
+E                       "pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lifecycle:job:'||jid,0));\n"
+E                       ' END LOOP;\n'
+E                       ' UPDATE public.lifecycle_claims c SET '
+E                       'replay_floor=generation,generation=generation+1,\n'

+E                       ' WHERE c.subject_id=target OR c.reservation_subject_id=target OR '
+E                       "(c.kind='demand' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM "
+E                       'public.job_payload_demands d WHERE d.id::text=c.work_id AND '
+E                       'd.user_id=target)) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM '
+E                       'public.capacity_reservations r\n'
+E                       "  WHERE r.subject_id=target AND r.state='held' AND "
+E                       'r.claim_kind=c.kind AND r.claim_id=c.work_id AND '
+E                       'r.generation=c.generation);\n'
+E                       ' UPDATE public.capacity_reservations r SET '
+E                       "state='fenced',terminal_at=clock_timestamp()\n"
+E                       ' FROM public.lifecycle_claims c WHERE c.kind=r.claim_kind AND '

+E                       'proname': 'lifecycle_job_state',

+E                       'text)\n'

+E                       ' STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       '  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n'

+E                       'DECLARE c public.lifecycle_claims; allocated numeric;\n'

+E                       "change'; END IF;\n"

+E                       '  RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'

+E                       " IF NEW.state='fenced' THEN\n"

+E                       '   OR c.generation<=c.replay_floor OR '

+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       "  IF NEW.state='settled' AND (NEW.backend_pid IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       'pg_backend_pid() OR NEW.transaction_id IS DISTINCT FROM '

+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF NEW.state='held' AND NEW.backend_pid IS NOT NULL THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF c.reservation_subject_bound AND c.reservation_subject_id IS '
+E                       'DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id THEN\n'

+E                   },

+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE e public.source_enumerations; c public.lifecycle_claims; '

+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'source generation and replay floor are "
+E                       "monotonic'; END IF;\n"
+E                       '  RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN e:=NEW;\n"
+E                       ' ELSE SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM public.source_enumerations '
+E                       'WHERE id=NEW.enumeration_id;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' SELECT replay_floor INTO STRICT floor FROM '
+E                       'public.source_accounts WHERE id=e.source_id;\n'
+E                       " IF e.sequence<=floor THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'enumeration sequence "
+E                       "rejected by replay floor'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " SELECT * INTO c FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE kind='source' "
+E                       'AND work_id=e.source_id::text\n'
+E                       ' AND owner_token=e.owner_token AND generation=e.generation AND '
+E                       'generation>replay_floor\n'
+E                       " AND state='active' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND "

+E                       " IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale, foreign or fenced "
+E                       "enumeration claim'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='enumeration_members' AND e.status<>'running' "
+E                       'THEN\n'

+E                       "change';\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'

+E                       "  IF NEW.generation<>e.generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale "
+E                       "checkpoint claim'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_enumerations' THEN\n"
+E                       "  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n"
+E                       '   IF NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.source_id<>OLD.source_id OR '

+E                       '   END IF;\n'

+E                       '   END IF;\n'
+E                       '   IF NEW.owner_token<>OLD.owner_token OR '
+E                       'NEW.generation<>OLD.generation THEN\n'
+E                       '    -- The current same-source claim was validated above. A '
+E                       'takeover fences its\n'
+E                       '    -- old generation first; only ownership may change on an '
+E                       'unfinished complete\n'
+E                       '    -- snapshot. Completion/evidence identity and cursor are '
+E                       'never reconstructed.\n'
+E                       "    IF OLD.status<>'complete' OR OLD.reconciled_at IS NOT NULL\n"
+E                       '       OR NEW.generation<=OLD.generation OR '

+E                       ' INSERT INTO '

+E                   {

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_stamp_consumption()\n'

+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' IF NEW.consumed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consumed_at THEN\n'

+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'public',
+E                       'proname': 'lifecycle_validate_row',
+E                       'arguments': '',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_validate_row()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; n jsonb; o jsonb; jid text; '
+E                       'growth bigint:=0;\n'
+E                       ' payload text; oldpayload text; k text; vid text; owner_id uuid; '
+E                       'protection boolean:=false;\n'
+E                       ' rid uuid; json_keys text[];\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       ' SELECT * INTO STRICT ctl FROM public.lifecycle_control WHERE '
+E                       'singleton;\n'
+E                       " n:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE "
+E                       'to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n'
+E                       " o:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) "
+E                       'END;\n'
+E                       " jid:=CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN n->>'id' ELSE "
+E                       "n->>'job_id' END;\n"
+E                       ' IF jid IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM '
+E                       "pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lifecycle:job:'||jid,0)); "
+E                       'END IF;\n'
+E                       ' -- Task10 AFTER projection trigger and deferred exact pairing '
+E                       'replace the old placeholder.\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "
+E                       "('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') AND current_user NOT "
+E                       "IN ('anon','authenticated') THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF lifecycle_private.operational_update(TG_TABLE_NAME,n,o) THEN '
+E                       'RETURN NEW; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF ctl.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n"
+E                       "  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','source_accounts','source_listings') "
+E                       "AND TG_OP='DELETE' THEN\n"
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lean lifecycle identity deletion is disabled "
+E                       "after cutover';\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions') AND (TG_OP='DELETE' "
+E                       'OR\n'
+E                       "   (TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND o->>'description' IS NOT NULL AND "
+E                       "(n->>'description' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'description' OR "
+E                       "n->>'description_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       "o->>'description_version_id')) OR\n"
+E                       "   (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_questions' AND (n->'questions' IS DISTINCT "
+E                       "FROM o->'questions' OR n->>'job_version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       "o->>'job_version_id'))) THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_reviews WHERE job_id=jid AND '
+E                       "verdict='approve')\n"
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.review_corrections WHERE '
+E                       'job_id=jid)\n'
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.application_packages WHERE '
+E                       'job_id=jid)\n'
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.resume_scores WHERE job_id=jid)\n'
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.cover_letter_edits WHERE '
+E                       'job_id=jid)\n'
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.generation_jobs WHERE job_id=jid '
+E                       "AND status IN ('pending','running'))\n"
+E                       '   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_payload_demands WHERE '
+E                       "job_id=jid AND status IN ('pending','running') AND "
+E                       'COALESCE(lease_until,protection_until)>clock_timestamp())\n'
+E                       "  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'job payload is protected'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n"
+E                       " owner_id:=(n->>'user_id')::uuid;\n"
+E                       " IF current_user='authenticated' AND owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM "
+E                       'public.app_user_id() THEN\n'
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign lifecycle owner' USING "
+E                       "ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' protection:=TG_TABLE_NAME IN '
+E                       "('review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits')\n"
+E                       " OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_reviews' AND n->>'verdict'='approve')\n"
+E                       " OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='generation_jobs' AND n->>'status' IN "
+E                       "('pending','running','ready'))\n"
+E                       " OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND "
+E                       "n->>'status'='ready');\n"
+E                       ' IF protection THEN\n'
+E                       "  vid:=n->>'job_version_id';\n"
+E                       "  IF vid IS NULL OR (NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND "
+E                       "n->>'kind'='questions') AND n->>'description_snapshot' IS NULL "
+E                       'AND NOT EXISTS(\n'
+E                       '    SELECT FROM public.jobs WHERE id=jid AND description IS NOT '
+E                       'NULL AND description_version_id::text=vid)) THEN\n'
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'protection requires version-ready payload or "
+E                       "durable snapshot'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready' "
+E                       "AND n->>'kind'='questions'\n"
+E                       " AND (n->'questions_snapshot' IS NULL OR "
+E                       "n->'questions_snapshot'='null'::jsonb)\n"
+E                       ' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.job_questions WHERE job_id=jid '
+E                       "AND job_version_id::text=n->>'job_version_id') THEN\n"
+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ready question demand requires version-ready "
+E                       "questions or snapshot';\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status' IN "
+E                       "('pending','running') THEN\n"
+E                       '  IF '
+E                       "COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz) "
+E                       'IS NULL OR '
+E                       "COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp()\n"
+E                       '    OR '
+E                       "COALESCE((n->>'lease_until')::timestamptz,(n->>'protection_until')::timestamptz)>clock_timestamp()+interval "
+E                       "'180 seconds' THEN\n"
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'active demand requires bounded database-time "
+E                       "lease'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' -- Payload fields are charged on every rewrite, including '
+E                       'same-size replacements;\n'
+E                       ' -- a prior DELETE or shrink never supplies physical allocation '
+E                       'credit.\n'
+E                       ' IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN '
+E                       "('jobs','job_questions','job_reviews','review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits','generation_jobs','job_payload_demands') "
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       '  -- Inspect actual declared types: JSON numeric/boolean/string '
+E                       'scalars are\n'
+E                       '  -- payload too. SQL numeric metadata is not confused with a '

+E                       '  SELECT array_agg(attname::text) INTO json_keys FROM '
+E                       'pg_attribute\n'
+E                       '   WHERE attrelid=TG_RELID AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped\n'
+E                       "   AND atttypid IN ('jsonb'::regtype,'json'::regtype);\n"
+E                       '  FOR k,payload IN SELECT key,value FROM jsonb_each_text(n) LOOP\n'
+E                       '   oldpayload:=o->>k;\n'
+E                       '   IF payload IS NOT NULL AND payload IS DISTINCT FROM '
+E                       'oldpayload\n'
+E                       '     AND (k=ANY(json_keys) AND n->k NOT IN '
+E                       "('{}'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)\n"
+E                       "       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k) IN ('object','array') AND payload "
+E                       "NOT IN ('{}','[]')\n"
+E                       "       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k)='string' AND\n"
+E                       '       (octet_length(payload)>256 OR (k NOT IN (\n'
+E                       '        '
+E                       "'id','user_id','job_id','job_version_id','profile_version','verdict','stage1_decision',\n"
+E                       '        '
+E                       "'experience_match','confidence','work_arrangement','pay_period','status','kind',\n"
+E                       '        '
+E                       "'description_capture_provenance','capture_provenance','description_version_id',\n"
+E                       "        'claim_owner_token','lease_until','protection_until') AND "
+E                       "k NOT LIKE '%\\_at' ESCAPE '\\')))\n"
+E                       '   THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(payload)*4+256; END IF;\n'
+E                       '  END LOOP;\n'
+E                       "  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN "
+E                       'growth:=growth+octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' ELSE\n'
+E                       '  IF n IS DISTINCT FROM o THEN '
+E                       'growth:=octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' IF growth>0 THEN\n'
+E                       '  BEGIN '
+E                       "rid:=NULLIF(current_setting('lifecycle.reservation',true),'')::uuid;\n"
+E                       '  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '
+E                       "'growth_without_reservation'; END;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' INSERT INTO '
+E                       'public.lifecycle_write_checks(invoking_role,subject_id,reservation_id,job_id,scope,bytes,row_count)\n'
+E                       ' '
+E                       'VALUES(current_user,public.app_user_id(),rid,jid,TG_TABLE_NAME,growth,1);\n'
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',

+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'public',
+E                       'proname': 'matching_paused',
+E                       'arguments': 'uid uuid',
+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.matching_paused(uid uuid)\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS boolean\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       ' SELECT NOT EXISTS (\n'
+E                       '   SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.user_id=uid AND s.plan '
+E                       "IN ('standard','pro')\n"
+E                       "     AND s.status='active' AND "
+E                       "nullif(s.stripe_subscription_id,'') IS NOT NULL\n"
+E                       "     AND s.current_period_end + interval '3 days' > "

+E                       'proconfig': [

+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'public',
+E                       'proname': 'preserve_lifecycle_control',
+E                       'arguments': '',

+E                       ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION "
+E                       "'lifecycle control history cannot be removed'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NOT NEW.archive_ever_activated '
+E                       "THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation history is monotonic'; "
+E                       'END IF;\n'
+E                       ' IF OLD.identity_migration_activated_at IS NOT NULL AND '
+E                       'NEW.identity_migration_activated_at IS DISTINCT FROM '
+E                       'OLD.identity_migration_activated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '
+E                       "'identity migration activation is immutable'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' IF NEW.activation_generation<OLD.activation_generation OR '
+E                       "NEW.flags_version<OLD.flags_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control "
+E                       "generation and schema version are monotonic'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'identity_migration_activated_at') IS DISTINCT "
+E                       "FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'identity_migration_activated_at') AND "
+E                       'NEW.activation_generation<=OLD.activation_generation THEN RAISE '
+E                       "EXCEPTION 'control changes require a newer activation "
+E                       "generation'; END IF;\n"
+E                       " IF NEW.safety_stage='enforced' AND OLD.safety_stage<>'enforced' "
+E                       'OR (NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run) THEN\n'
+E                       '  IF NOT (NEW.identity_enabled AND NEW.source_enabled AND '
+E                       'NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n'
+E                       '    OR NOT '

+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle activation requires compatible "
+E                       "writer and backfill readiness'; END IF;\n"
+E                       '  IF NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run AND '
+E                       "NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n"
+E                       "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retirement requires enforced lifecycle "
+E                       "stage'; END IF;\n"
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF OLD.safety_stage='enforced' AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' "
+E                       "THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe legacy rollback after cutover'; END "
+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       " IF NEW.archive_stage<> 'never_activated' AND NOT "
+E                       'OLD.archive_ever_activated OR NEW.export_enabled AND NOT '

+E                       "  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND "

+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' IF NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled AND NOT '

+E                       "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive export requires completed bounded "

+E                       'IF;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END $function$\n',
+E                       'proconfig': [

+E                       ],
+E                       'prosecdef': False,
+E                       'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {
+E                       'nspname': 'public',
+E                       'proname': 'resume_matching',

+E                       'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resume_matching()\n'
+E                       ' RETURNS TABLE(status text, existing boolean)\n'
+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE uid uuid := public.app_user_id(); was_paused boolean; req '
+E                       'review_requests%ROWTYPE;\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n"
+E                       " PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n"
+E                       ' PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n'
+E                       ' IF uid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE '
+E                       'user_id=uid) THEN\n'

+E                       ' END IF;\n'

+E                       " IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile required' USING "
+E                       "ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n"

+E                       'paused account.\n'

+E                       "clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days'\n"
+E                       ' INTO was_paused FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid;\n'
+E                       ' UPDATE matching_activity SET '
+E                       'last_meaningful_at=clock_timestamp(),paused_at=NULL WHERE '
+E                       'user_id=uid;\n'
+E                       ' INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid)\n'
+E                       ' ON CONFLICT (user_id) WHERE review_requests.status IN '
+E                       "('pending','running') DO NOTHING\n"

+E                       ' IF FOUND THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN; END '

+E                       'row lock. Retry\n'
+E                       ' -- insertion if so; never return a synthetic pending success '
+E                       'without durable work.\n'
+E                       ' SELECT * INTO req FROM review_requests WHERE user_id=uid AND '
+E                       "review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') FOR UPDATE;\n"
+E                       ' IF NOT FOUND THEN\n'
+E                       '   INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid) RETURNING * '
+E                       'INTO req;\n'
+E                       '   RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; RETURN;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       " IF was_paused AND req.status='running' THEN\n"
+E                       '   UPDATE review_requests SET resume_requested=true WHERE '
+E                       'id=req.id;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,true;\n'
+E                       'END\n'
+E                       '$function$\n',

+E                       'owner': 'postgres',
+E                   },
+E                   {

+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+E                       ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+E                       " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
+E                       'AS $function$\n'
+E                       'DECLARE caller uuid := public.app_user_id();\n'
+E                       'BEGIN\n'
+E                       " PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n"
+E                       " PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n"
+E                       ' PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n'
+E                       "  IF caller IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication "
+E                       "required' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;\n"
+E                       '  -- A fresh post-lock snapshot prevents stale-snapshot rate '
+E                       'bypasses.\n'
+E                       "  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' "
+E                       'THEN\n'
+E                       "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'read committed required' USING ERRCODE = "
+E                       "'25000';\n"
+E                       '  END IF;\n'
+E                       '  IF p_kind IS NULL OR p_kind NOT IN '
+E                       "('issue','criticism','feature_request')\n"
+E                       '     OR p_message IS NULL OR char_length(p_message) > 4000\n'
+E                       "     OR p_message !~ '[^[:space:]]' THEN\n"
+E                       "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid feedback' USING ERRCODE = '22023';\n"
+E                       '  END IF;\n'
+E                       "  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('feedback:' || "
+E                       'caller::text, 0));\n'
+E                       '  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletions WHERE user_id '
+E                       '= caller) THEN\n'
+E                       "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'account deleted' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n"
+E                       '  END IF;\n'
+E                       '  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.feedback WHERE user_id = '
+E                       'caller\n'
+E                       "      AND created_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour') >= "
+E                       '5 THEN\n'
+E                       "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feedback rate limit' USING ERRCODE = "
+E                       "'P0001';\n"
+E                       '  END IF;\n'
+E                       '  INSERT INTO public.feedback(user_id, kind, message) VALUES '
+E                       '(caller, p_kind, btrim(p_message));\n'
+E                       'END;\n'
+E                       '$function$\n',

+E                       ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'

+E                       " SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\n"

+E                       'actor=public.app_user_id()\n'

+E                       'coalesce(paused_at,clock_timestamp()) ELSE paused_at END,\n'
+E                       '     last_meaningful_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE user_id=actor;\n'
+E                       ' END IF;\n'
+E                       ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+E                       'END\n'

(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id']) IS DISTINCT FROM\n    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['consumed_at','replacement_batch_id'])\n OR OLD.approved_at>clock_timestamp() OR OLD.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()\n OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.replacement_batch_id\n  AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND b.state='claimed') r.source_id=sid AND r.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND r.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()\n AND r.invoking_role=current_user AND r.subject_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id()\n AND c.invoking_role=r.invoking_role AND c.subject_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.subject_id\n AND c.state='active' AND c.generation>c.replay_floor AND c.lease_until>clock_timestamp())\n$function$\n", text, n jsonb, o jsonb', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.operational_update(t text, n jsonb, o jsonb)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE sid uuid; fields text[];\nBEGIN\n IF t='source_accounts' THEN sid:=(n->>'id')::uuid;\n  fields:=ARRAY['last_attempt_at','last_complete_success_at','last_outcome','next_due_at','failure_streak','suspicious_empty_streak'];\n ELSIF t='source_listings' THEN sid:=(n->>'source_account_id')::uuid;\n  fields:=ARRAY['source_availability','successful_last_observed_at','successful_sighting_count','consecutive_complete_misses','first_complete_miss_at'];\n ELSIF t='jobs' THEN\n  SELECT l.source_account_id INTO sid FROM public.source_listings l JOIN public.lifecycle_operational_listings p ON p.listing_id=l.id\n    WHERE l.job_id=n->>'id' AND lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(l.source_account_id) LIMIT 1;\n  fields:=ARRAY['closed_at'];\n ELSE RETURN false;\n END IF;\n IF sid IS NULL OR NOT lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(sid) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n IF t='source_accounts' AND n->>'last_outcome' NOT IN ('attempting','complete','partial','failed','suspicious_empty') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid bounded source outcome'; END IF;\n IF n-fields IS DISTINCT FROM o-fields THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational update exceeds fixed field allowlist'; END IF;\n IF t='source_listings' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_operational_listings WHERE listing_id=(n->>'id')::uuid) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational listing not preallocated'; END IF;\n UPDATE public.lifecycle_operational_receipts SET row_count=row_count+1 WHERE source_id=sid;\n RETURN true;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': lifecycle_private.preserve_archive_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF TG_OP='TRUNCATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive pending/history cannot be truncated'; END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('public_archive_items','public_archive_receipts','public_archive_batches') AND EXISTS(\n  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batch_markers m WHERE m.batch_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'batch_id')::uuid\n   AND m.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND OLD.state='superseded' AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n   AND s.replaced_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_items' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND s.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n    AND Completion/evidence identity and cursor are never reconstructed.\n    IF OLD.status<>'complete' OR OLD.reconciled_at IS NOT NULL\n       OR NEW.generation<=OLD.generation OR c.replay_floor<OLD.generation\n       OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'owner_token'-'generation') IS DISTINCT FROM\n          (to_jsonb(OLD)-'owner_token'-'generation') THEN\n     RAISE EXCEPTION 'only completed pending reconciliation permits ownership handoff';\n    END IF;\n   END IF;\n  END IF;\n END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.lifecycle_write_checks(invoking_role,subject_id,owner_token,generation)\n VALUES(current_user,public.app_user_id(),e.owner_token,e.generation);\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_stamp_consumption', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_stamp_consumption()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF NEW.consumed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consumed_at THEN\n  IF OLD.status<>'ready' OR OLD.job_version_id IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(OLD.description_snapshot),'') IS NULL THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'consumption requires durable ready snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  NEW.consumed_at:=clock_timestamp();\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'public', 'proname': 'lifecycle_validate_row', 'arguments': '', 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lifecycle_validate_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n owner_id:=(n->>'user_id')::uuid;\n IF current_user='authenticated' AND owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign lifecycle owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n protection:=TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_reviews' AND n->>'verdict'='approve')\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='generation_jobs' AND n->>'status' IN ('pending','running','ready'))\n OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'status'='ready');\n IF protection THEN\n  vid:=n->>'job_version_id';\n  IF vid IS NULL OR (NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME='job_payload_demands' AND n->>'kind'='questions') AND n->>'description_snapshot' IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(\n    SELECT FROM public.jobs WHERE id=jid AND description IS NOT NULL AND description_version_id::text=vid)) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'protection requires version-ready payload or durable snapshot'; SQL numeric metadata is not confused with a JSON scalar.\n  SELECT array_agg(attname::text) INTO json_keys FROM pg_attribute\n   WHERE attrelid=TG_RELID AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped\n   AND atttypid IN ('jsonb'::regtype,'json'::regtype);\n  FOR k,payload IN SELECT key,value FROM jsonb_each_text(n) LOOP\n   oldpayload:=o->>k;\n   IF payload IS NOT NULL AND payload IS DISTINCT FROM oldpayload\n     AND (k=ANY(json_keys) AND n->k NOT IN ('{}'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k) IN ('object','array') AND payload NOT IN ('{}','[]')\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k)='string' AND\n       (octet_length(payload)>256 OR (k NOT IN (\n        'id','user_id','job_id','job_version_id','profile_version','verdict','stage1_decision',\n        'experience_match','confidence','work_arrangement','pay_period','status','kind',\n        'description_capture_provenance','capture_provenance','description_version_id',\n        'claim_owner_token','lease_until','protection_until') AND k NOT LIKE '%\\_at' ESCAPE '\\')))\n   THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(payload)*4+256; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND TG_OP='INSERT' THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF n IS DISTINCT FROM o THEN growth:=octet_length(n::text)*4+1024; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF growth>0 THEN\n  BEGIN rid:=NULLIF(current_setting('lifecycle.reservation',true),'')::uuid;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NOT NEW.archive_ever_activated THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation history is monotonic'; END IF;\n IF OLD.identity_migration_activated_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.identity_migration_activated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.identity_migration_activated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity migration activation is immutable'; END IF;\n IF NEW.activation_generation<OLD.activation_generation OR NEW.flags_version<OLD.flags_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control generation and schema version are monotonic'; END IF;\n IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'identity_migration_activated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'identity_migration_activated_at') AND NEW.activation_generation<=OLD.activation_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control changes require a newer activation generation'; END IF;\n IF NEW.safety_stage='enforced' AND OLD.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR (NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run) THEN\n  IF NOT (NEW.identity_enabled AND NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle activation requires compatible writer and backfill readiness'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retirement requires enforced lifecycle stage'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF OLD.safety_stage='enforced' AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe legacy rollback after cutover'; END IF;\n IF NEW.archive_stage<> 'never_activated' AND NOT OLD.archive_ever_activated OR NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive activation requires validated destination and producer readiness'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF NEW.export_enabled AND NOT OLD.export_enabled AND NOT lifecycle_private.archive_baseline_ready() THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive export requires completed bounded baseline'; END IF;\n IF OLD.archive_ever_activated AND NEW.archive_stage='active' AND OLD.archive_stage<>'active' THEN\n  IF NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' OR NOT (NEW.source_enabled AND NEW.maintenance_enabled AND NEW.hydration_enabled)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.release_ready(OLD.activation_generation)\n    OR NOT lifecycle_private.archive_destination_ready() THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive producer readiness unavailable';
